name: Chakuyak

angles.text: As a tauren, you know the balance between reverence for nature and the duty to protect your tribe. Using a slain beast’s pelt honors it.
As a hunter, you need patience and keen senses to track a fierce, solitary alpha wolf through wooded hills. Treat the predator with respect.

faq.answer: Chakuyak is a large, unusually aggressive prairie wolf who threatens travelers in Mulgore.
Chakuyak prowls the tree stands west of Stonebull Lake, among the wooded hills.
Chakuyak has grown bold and aggressive, making her a danger to travelers arriving from abroad.
faq.q: Why must Chakuyak be hunted down?

faq.answer: Her pelt is preserved and put to use, so nothing is wasted.
faq.q: What happens to Chakuyak's pelt after the hunt?

faq.answer: Chakuyak is exceptionally fierce. Travelers often join small hunting parties to track and bring her down safely.
faq.q: Do I need a group to hunt Chakuyak?

faq.answer: The hunter who set the hunt promises to praise your deed to the tribe’s chief when you return with Chakuyak’s pelt.
faq.q: Who acknowledges your victory over Chakuyak?

sections.body: Chakuyak prowls the tree stands west of Stonebull Lake, where prairie wolves roam Mulgore’s grassy plateaus and rolling hills. This fierce alpha female has become a danger to travelers arriving from abroad, so local hunters have marked her for removal before more wanderers are harmed.
sections.title: The Shadow of Stonebull Lake

sections.body: For the local tribes, killing Chakuyak calls for solemn respect, not boasting. They see it as necessary to protect travelers and villagers. Her thick pelt is cured and put to use, honoring the wolf and ensuring her sacrifice is not wasted.
sections.title: Reverence and Necessity

summary: Near the tree stands west of Stonebull Lake, Chakuyak threatens travelers crossing Mulgore. Local tribesfolk have marked the fierce wolf for hunting, and her pelt will be honored.
